author: Darrin Black
title: EPS for Sanofi (SNY) Expected At $0.63
text:
EPS for Sanofi (SNY) Expected At $0.63 Posted by Darrin Black 41 am
Analysts expect Sanofi (NASDAQ:SNY) to report $0.63 EPS on February, 6.They anticipate $0.01 EPS change or 1.61 % from last quarter’s $0.62 EPS. SNY’s profit would be $1.56 billion giving it 16.99 P/E if the $0.63 EPS is correct. After having $1.07 EPS previously, Sanofi’s analysts see -41.12 increased 0.90% or $0.38 $42.82. About 1.51 million shares traded or 22.05% up from the average. Sanofi (NASDAQ:SNY) has risen 2.03% uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.03% the S&P500.
Sanofi researches, develops, manufactures, and markets therapeutic solutions. $106.18 billion. The firm operates in two divisions, Pharmaceuticals and Vaccines. It has a 22.07 P/E ratio. It offers Cerezyme and Cerdelga for Gaucher disease, Myozyme and Lumizyme for Pompe disease, Fabrazyme for Fabry disease, and Aldurazyme for mucopolysaccharidosis Type 1; and Aubagio, an oral immunomodulatory and Lemtrada, a monoclonal antibody to treat multiple sclerosis.
